turns.text:
`order.fig` holds one small mobile screen: an order-status card in a dark theme.

**Structure:** One page, "Showcase", with a single frame "Order" (`1735549286:1`). It's 360 wide and 365 tall, uses vertical auto-layout with 24px padding and 20px gaps, and is set in Inter throughout. Top to bottom:

1. **Title:** "Your order" (28 Bold) with the subtitle "Placed 2 Oct · 3 items" (14 Regular, muted).
2. **Card** (radius 20, 1px border, soft drop shadow, 20px padding):
   - **Header:** a 44×44 rounded icon tile with a Lucide package icon, then "Order #4821" (17 Bold) over "Arriving tomorrow, 9–12".
   - **Progress bar:** an 8px track with the accent fill covering 196 of 272px, about 72%.
   - **Steps:** "Packed" and "Shipped" in muted text, then "Out for delivery" highlighted in the accent colour.
3. **Button:** a full-width "Track order" button with a Lucide arrow, 50px tall, radius 14, accent fill.
4. **Footnote:** "Delivered to the door · no signature" (13 Regular, muted).

**Tokens:** There's one variable collection, "Theme", with Light and Dark modes. Every fill and stroke in the screen is bound to one of its 9 colours, and the screen currently shows Dark:

| Token | Dark | Light |
|---|---|---|
| Background | #0D1117 | #F6F4EE |
| Surface | #161B22 | #FFFFFF |
| Ink | #F6F4EE | #15171C |
| Muted | #9DA3AB | #6B6F76 |
| Border | #30363D | #E6E2D8 |
| Accent | #C6F26B (lime) | #13704B (green) |
| Accent soft | #1C2B23 | #E3F4EA |
| On accent | #15171C | #FFFFFF |
| Track | #21262D | #ECE8DE |

The file has no components, styles or images.

Two things in the file look off:
- The title layer is named "My order", but its text says "Your order".
- The 196px progress fill is a fixed width, not tied to a step, so it won't follow the status if that changes.
Make it light, and check the contrast.

turns.text:
I switched the Order frame to the Theme collection's Light mode and saved it as a new file, **`order-light.fig`**. The original `order.fig` hasn't changed. I didn't edit any colours, because every fill was already bound to a variable and they all switch with the mode. The saved file read back identical to what I wrote, but it still needs opening in Figma to confirm it imports correctly.

**Contrast: all 9 text layers pass WCAG 2.2 AA in Light mode.**

| Text | Colour on background | Ratio | Needs |
|---|---|---|---|
| Order #4821 | #15171C on #FFFFFF | 17.9 | 4.5 |
| Your order (large) | #15171C on #F6F4EE | 16.3 | 3.0 |
| Out for delivery | #13704B on #FFFFFF | 6.09 | 4.5 |
| Track order | #FFFFFF on #13704B | 6.09 | 4.5 |
| Arriving tomorrow, Packed, Shipped | #6B6F76 on #FFFFFF | 5.04 | 4.5 |
| Placed 2 Oct · 3 items, Delivered to the door · no signature | #6B6F76 on #F6F4EE | **4.58** | 4.5 |

The two muted lines that sit directly on the page background only just pass. If anyone makes the Light `Muted` or `Background` tokens a little lighter, they'll fail. Darkening Light `Muted` to about #5F636A would give more room and change little visually.

The check only covers text. The icons and the progress bar's filled part are the dark green accent on white or light beige, so they should easily clear the 3:1 needed for non-text elements, but I didn't measure them.

turns.text:
I turned the screen into a single HTML file, **`order.html`**, in the folder above `designs/`. Nothing pointed to a framework, so it's plain HTML and CSS with no build step; it loads Inter from Google Fonts.

**I haven't seen it in a browser.** I can't reach a browser from this session, so I haven't compared it against the Figma render. Open it next to the earlier render to check.

**How it maps to the design:**
- **Layout:** Each auto-layout frame is a flexbox with the same gaps, padding, radii, border and shadow. Text sizes and weights match, with `line-height: 1` as in the file.
- **Colours:** The 9 Theme variables are CSS custom properties. Light is the default; adding `data-theme="dark"` to any parent switches to the Dark values.
- **Icons:** The package and arrow icons are inline SVGs made from the file's own vector paths, drawn in the current text colour. The file doesn't record their line-end style, so I used rounded ends, which is how these Lucide icons are drawn and how they looked in the render.
- **Markup:**
  - The title and order number are headings, and the steps are an ordered list with "Out for delivery" marked as the current step.
  - "Track order" is a real `<button>` with a visible keyboard focus ring.
  - The progress bar is announced as a progress bar at 72%, which is the design's 196 of 272px. The fill comes from a `--progress` variable, so the bar can follow the real status. This deals with the fixed-width fill I mentioned earlier.

**Not done:**
- The screen is a fixed 360px wide, as in the design; it doesn't stretch to other screen sizes.
- The button doesn't do anything yet.
- The text content is hard-coded, not filled from data.

If you're targeting React, SwiftUI, Tailwind or something else, tell me and I'll port it.
